answer: Adjudication must be committed before it is read. Every grader hashes its verdict on a random peer's work, then reveals; graders whose verdicts agree far more often than chance - especially inside one funding cluster - have their copper-weighted votes voided and their bonds tide away to challengers who surface the correlation. A farm's thousand clones evaluate through the same generator, so their verdicts correlate like fingerprints, and the whole canyon of pooled bonds collapses on one statistical test. Honest graders disagree naturally, and random pairing never samples the same pairs twice.
